title: Webb Telescope Reveals Sharper Detail in the Pillars of Creation
summary: New near-infrared imaging from the James Webb Space Telescope shows finer structure inside the Pillars of Creation than earlier Hubble images could resolve, including newly forming stars hidden inside the dust.

title: LIGO Detects the Most Massive Black Hole Merger Ever Observed
summary: The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration detected gravitational waves from a black hole merger that produced a final black hole roughly 225 times the mass of the Sun, the heaviest ever recorded this way.

title: Mathematicians Find a New Way to Count Prime Numbers
summary: Researchers proved a decades-old conjecture about primes expressible as a sum of a square and four times a square, using a technique borrowed from an unrelated area of number theory.

title: A Step Toward the Riemann Hypothesis, Math's Biggest Open Problem
summary: Two mathematicians ruled out a class of possible exceptions to the Riemann Hypothesis, the first real progress in decades on the century-old problem underlying the distribution of prime numbers.

title: NIH-Funded Team Shrinks CRISPR for More Precise Delivery in the Body
summary: A smaller, engineered CRISPR enzyme variant could make gene-editing therapies safer and easier to deliver directly into the body, rather than only in cells modified outside it.

title: Google's Willow Chip Marks a Milestone in Quantum Error Correction
summary: Google's new 105-qubit Willow processor demonstrated that adding more qubits can reduce errors instead of increasing them, a long-sought threshold for building reliable, large-scale quantum computers.
